bio: International customers flock to the sixth floor of 39 Avenue George V... and for good reason! Overlooking the rooftops of Paris, you will enjoy consummately crafted, polished French food. After a major makeover, every detail, from the wooden parquet floor to the made-to-measure seating and the haute couture crockery, has been preened and pondered over. The epitome of understated luxury!...
